changelog: feat: add pageviews tool — daily view counts for any Wikipedia article over a date range via Wikimedia's pageviews REST API (cross-wiki metric, hosted on wikimedia.org). Default window = last 7 days ending yesterday UTC. Returns total + daily average + markdown table. 11 tools total, 102/102 tests pass.
summary: Access Wikipedia via MCP — search articles, get summaries, random facts, dinosaur facts, today's featured article, today's historical events, and article categories. Multi-language support (10 wikis). Great for research, content hooks, and general knowledge lookups.
